exec_summary: Site traffic (GA4, 2026-08-29 to 2026-09-04): growthbook.io had 3,379 sessions and 1,798 users (+3.0% week over week).

**Site performance**
- **Overall (GA4, all traffic):** 3,379 sessions (+3.0% WoW) | 1,798 users

- **Homepage (/):** 2,230 GA4 sessions (+10.9% WoW) all-traffic | 1,735 GSC clicks (-9.4% WoW) organic | 9,368 GSC impressions (-3.9% WoW)
- **Pricing (/pricing):** 498 GA4 sessions (-2.2% WoW) all-traffic | 97 GSC clicks (-6.7% WoW) organic | 4,291 GSC impressions (-8.1% WoW)
- **Docs (docs.growthbook.io):** 345 GA4 sessions (-89.4% WoW) all-traffic | 1,025 GSC clicks (-2.0% WoW) organic | 73,702 GSC impressions (-0.2% WoW)

- Docs GA4 sessions crashed -89.4% WoW (345 vs ~3,200 last week) while docs GSC organic is essentially flat (-2.0%). Likely a GA4 tracking or subdomain configuration issue on docs.growthbook.io -- worth checking before treating as real. Homepage GA4 all-traffic is up +10.9% while GSC organic clicks are down -9.4% -- consistent with AI-channel traffic arriving outside Google's view.
- All-other-pages impressions +12.9% with GSC clicks +7.7% is a positive signal -- non-branded organic reach is expanding.

**New competitor activity**
- **Optimizely** published a coordinated block of vertical-specific experimentation use-case pages (financial services, media checkout, media landing pages, media mobile app, retail banking, telecom, B2B software) plus an **"Experimentation RFP Template"** guide (KD 33, threat score 8) and a "173,000 Experiments" content asset. - **PostHog**'s /compare section surfaced in our tracking (74 pages) -- a hub of comparison and alternatives pages covering analytics, product intelligence, and AI observability tools. Notably includes **"Best GrowthBook Alternatives"** and **"PostHog vs GrowthBook"** pages directly targeting GrowthBook's brand. This is a sitemap addition of mostly pre-existing content, not 74 pages published this week, but the hub is now indexed and competing for BOFU queries.
- **Flagsmith** published **"AB Testing"** (KD 60) and **"AB Testing vs Canary"** (KD 45) -- higher-competition targets than their usual low-KD plays, signaling growing confidence in their domain authority. Also shipped **"Feature Flag vs Feature Branch"** (KD 0, tier 1).
- **Kameleoon** published **"Using Prompt-Based Experimentation: The Context vs The Model"** (tier 1) -- direct overlap with AI/LLM experimentation content GrowthBook has not addressed.
- **Datadog** published **"From Traces to Experiments: A Loop for Improving AI Agents"** (tier 1) -- continued push into AI agent experimentation, a space GrowthBook has no dedicated content for.

- ⚠️ Zero pages detected from **Eppo**, **Statsig**, and **Unleash** -- likely a monitoring gap for at least some of these.
